Name: Predicates
SQL:
-- sgl.query(Predicates, many)
SELECT isNull(note) AS missing, isNotNull(note) AS present, isZeroOrNull(score) AS zero_or_missing,
       empty(name) AS unnamed, has(tags, 'gull') AS tagged, like(name, 'g%') AS gull_like,
       startsWith(name, 'g') AS starts, mapContains(ringings, 'a') AS ringed,
       hasTokenOrNull(name, 'gull') AS has_token, isNaN(toFloat64(score)) AS not_a_number
FROM gulls;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:isNull(note)⟩ AS missing, ⟨c1 aliased:isNotNull(note)⟩ AS present, ⟨c2 aliased:isZeroOrNull(score)⟩ AS zero_or_missing,
       ⟨c3 aliased:empty(name)⟩ AS unnamed, ⟨c4 aliased:has(tags, 'gull')⟩ AS tagged, ⟨c5 aliased:like(name, 'g%')⟩ AS gull_like,
       ⟨c6 aliased:startsWith(name, 'g')⟩ AS starts, ⟨c7 aliased:mapContains(ringings, 'a')⟩ AS ringed,
       ⟨c8 aliased:hasTokenOrNull(name, 'gull')⟩ AS has_token, ⟨c9 aliased:isNaN(toFloat64(score))⟩ AS not_a_number
FROM gulls;

Name: LogicalResults
SQL:
-- sgl.query(LogicalResults, many)
SELECT and(score, 1) AS both_set, or(active, score) AS either, xor(score, 1) AS one_of, not(score) AS negated,
       NOT active AS inactive, NOT score AS zero, toBool(score) AS flag
FROM gulls;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:and(score, 1)⟩ AS both_set, ⟨c1 aliased:or(active, score)⟩ AS either, ⟨c2 aliased:xor(score, 1)⟩ AS one_of, ⟨c3 aliased:not(score)⟩ AS negated,\n       ⟨c4 aliased:NOT active⟩ AS inactive, ⟨c5 aliased:NOT score⟩ AS zero, ⟨c6 aliased:toBool(score)⟩ AS flag\nFROM gulls;
